class.name: SteamScoreUploadOperation
class.brief_description: Observes the Steam result of a submitted score.
class.description: Cancelling or stopping observation leaves any update Steam already accepted in place. The native write reservation remains until Steam settles the request.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Ends local observation with [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_SKIP]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST] when already settled.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns whether the operation has settled.

method.name: result
method.description: Returns the typed terminal result, or [code]null[/code] while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Use [code]await[/code] to receive a [SteamScoreUploadResult]. A settled operation returns the same result immediately.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once after the operation settles with its typed result.
